'''Unreleased cards''' are Decipher Star Wars CCG cards that were photographed, designed, or named in print and then never sold as a finished English card. Cancelled expansions are listed on [[Cancelled Expansions]]. This page is the leftover: individual cards and mechanics that never got a retail sheet.

== Light Side Mara Jade ==
[[File:Mara-Jade-Light-Side-unreleased.png|260px|Unreleased Light Side Mara Jade]]

[[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] was printed Dark Side in [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]]. At the same photo shoot, model Shannon Baksa was also photographed in a green suit for a Light Side Mara Jade. That card was never an official Decipher release. The Players Committee shared the archive photograph at MPC 2008. Photograph on this page is the Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 scan of that unreleased card (p.201).<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Wayback, 9 October 2026].</ref>

Forum search on starwarsccg.org for Shannon Baksa, "Mara Jade unreleased", "Mara Jade green", and "MPC 2008 Mara" did not turn up a higher-resolution original of this Light Side card. Baksa hits are about signed Dark Side oversized [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] cards at events. Guest search works; the local Edge profile used for forum logins is currently logged out, so a manpc-session search may still find a better scan.

== Fixer and other named-but-unprinted characters ==
Some printed cards talk about characters who never received their own Decipher card. The usual example is '''Fixer''', Camie's boyfriend from Tosche Station in ''A New Hope'': he is part of the film and of SWCCG table talk, but Decipher never printed a Fixer character card. The same gap applies to other film extras who show up in lore or in "search for a card named…" effects that point at a title that does not exist yet.

Treat those references as evidence that Decipher planned or at least named a card, not as proof a sheet was printed.

== Lichtenstein ==
[[Lichtenstein]] cards for [[Skywalkers (expansion)|Skywalkers]], [[Jedi Masters]], and [[Scoundrels]] would have given new abilities to existing Luke, Leia, Vader, Yoda, Obi-Wan, Emperor, Han, Lando, Boba Fett, and Jabba cards instead of printing new versions of those characters. None reached retail.<ref name="encyc" />

== Reflections Gold ==
[[Reflections Gold]] got furthest: Lucasfilm-approved art, sticker-on-white-border playtest copies, and a ~310-card list. Lucasfilm refused a free PDF release after the license ended. See that article for the list, mechanics (Credits, combos, blanks), and scans.

== Other language versions that never shipped ==
Planned language editions beyond Japanese Takara, and the cancelled German and Spanish releases, are on [[Translations of SWCCG]]. The cancelled German release, including the magazine advertisements and the Modern Graphics two-player rulebook, is on [[Cancelled German release of SWCCG]]. The surviving Spanish Two-Player rules proof is on [[Spanish Premiere Two-Player Game rules booklet]].<ref name="fb-sergio">[https://www.facebook.com/groups/starwarsccg/permalink/10159018539903127/ SWCCG Two-Player Game Rulesbook (Spanish).pdf], Sergio Domenech, Star Wars CCG Facebook group (8 September 2021). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/swccg-spanish-2pg-rules-booklet-1998 Internet Archive]; [[:File:Spanish_Premiere_Two-Player_Game_rules_booklet.pdf]].</ref>
